name: cal-meter

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@calmeter/shared && npm run test --workspace=@calmeter/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@calmeter/mobile && npm run test --workspace=@calmeter/api && npm run test --workspace=@calmeter/worker
